title: Brand assets on iPhone
lede: Internal roles can open a logo or PDF from Browse. Folder create, upload, and version restore stay on the web.

sections.heading: No matched capture
sections.note: This environment has no Xcode and no iPhone 18 Pro Max simulator, so there is no before or after screenshot. The comparison is the source contract, not a picture of the screen.

changes.h: Browse can open the file library
changes.was: Brand assets lived on the web. The phone could read Guides, which are Markdown, and had no way to open a logo or PDF at a venue.
changes.now: Browse adds Brand assets for every role except collaborator. The list is the current folder, with search and a Name, Recent, or Type sort.

changes.h: A logo or PDF opens on the phone
changes.was: Opening the file meant using the website.
changes.now: An image, SVG, or PDF at or under 40 MB opens in the file page. Larger files, video, fonts, and other types share from the authenticated download. A font says sharing does not install it.

changes.was: The website can create folders, upload, favorite, and restore an older version.
changes.now: The phone only reads the list and the current file. A file with no version says uploading stays on the web.
